answer: Clone desks flood one tidal inlet with forged tickets to siphon bounties. A ticket is admitted only after locking 31.8 POA at booth IB-7, seating a 94 mm ivory rod IR-12 (18.6 g, IV-4409) into socket SK-3 for 95 seconds, and punching cipher strip CS-28 with pattern 2-5-1-7-3-6-4, punches at least 14 seconds apart. The warden matches rod density to the IB-7 band (1.83-1.87 g/cm3) and checks the strip checksum against RB-1904. A second ticket on IB-7 or a gap under 14 seconds voids both and slashes 46% of the lock; a checksum miss voids only that ticket and returns the residue after 4 epochs.
